MAINTAINABILITY_SPLIT_PLAN.PURPOSE: Document safe post-release split boundaries for files above the 500-line maintainability target while keeping the public release candidate stable.

POLICY.RULE: The 1300-line hard gate remains blocking and must pass before release.
The 500-line target is a maintainability warning for mature modules, not a release blocker when tests, clippy, verify, review, and refresh pass.
Large files should be split only along stable module boundaries with tests moved in the same change.

FILE.SPLIT: Move HTML rendering helpers and page payload tests to dashboard_views/dashboard_payload modules after release.
FILE.RISK: Low runtime risk, moderate docs/test churn.

FILE.SPLIT: Move module default trace mappings and report rendering into traceability_defaults and traceability_render modules.
FILE.RISK: Moderate because strict traceability gates depend on this module.

FILE.SPLIT: Move graph construction and preview rendering into cascade_graph and cascade_render modules.
FILE.RISK: Moderate because preview execution writes artifacts.

FILE.SPLIT: Move typed LINKS parsing/validation into contract_links module.
FILE.RISK: Moderate because all MyGRACE gates use contract scanning.

FILE.SPLIT: Shard artifact-generation, traceability, testing, and status handlers into focused MCP helper modules.
FILE.RISK: Moderate because MCP tools/list parity must remain exact.

FILE.SPLIT: Move requirements, technology, development-plan, traceability, and non-human checks into verify_* helpers.
FILE.RISK: Low to moderate if check names stay stable.

RELEASE_DECISION.ACCEPTED: Do not split large files inside Phase-14 unless a hard gate fails. The safer release path is to ship after full gates and schedule module splits as Phase-15.
